top_band: Backrest front face in rows 2-5 (vertical), seat cushion top surface in rows 7-8 (light pink/peach horizontal band, 2 rows), front of seat cushion and frame in rows 9-11, legs in rows 12-13.
evidence: Reading down the middle column: row 1 is dark outline, rows 2-5 are the vertical front face of the backrest (4 rows), row 6 is a dark crease line. Below that, the seat cushion spans rows 7-10: rows 7-8 are lighter pink/peach (at most 2 rows of top surface, or a bevelled front cushion), and rows 9-10 are darker red front shading, followed by a dark outline in row 11 and 2 rows of legs (12-13). A 2-row band on the seat cushion is too thin to clearly read as a foreshortened horizontal seat surface from a 45-degree camera; the chair reads primarily as a front elevation with pillow bevels.

style.evidence: The armchair uses a 5-step red/pink ramp with a very dark maroon outline (dark material tone) and brown wooden legs. Shading has decent volume and pillow highlights, fitting a small 1-tile furniture prop reasonably well.
